entry.title: New: RES26-219 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT TO THE CITY OF TWO (2) HIGH-BACK TRADITIONAL BENCHES, PREPARATIONS OF THE GROUNDS, AND TWO (2) BRONZE PLAQUES WITH INSCRIPTIONS TO READ, “DONATED BY THE ‘OHANA OF LILY KWAN” AND "DONATED BY THE ‘OHANA OF CLARA KWAN,” VALUED AT $5,607.25, FROM CLARA KWAN TO BE PLACED AT AINA MOANA PARK WITHIN ALA MOANA REGIONAL PARK.

Latest action: Introduced.
